business.what_it_does: An API and set of tools that auto-generate template-based images, videos and PDFs (social media banners, ecommerce visuals, etc.) from a designed template filled with your own data.
business.category: Image and video generation API for marketing automation

facts.statement: Requesting multiple output formats in one render costs more credits: asking for jpg and png together costs two credits rather than one.

provenance.quote: Yes. Credits are counted per format, so asking for jpg and png costs two rather than one.

facts.statement: Using the scale parameter to increase output resolution multiplies the credit cost by the same scale factor.

provenance.quote: Use scale to multiply the output size. A scale of 2 on a 1200x630 template returns 2400x1260. Credits are multiplied by the scale as well.

facts.statement: AI face/subject detection costs one extra credit per layer that uses it, in addition to the render itself.

provenance.quote: Yes, one credit per layer that uses it, on top of the render itself.

facts.statement: Background removal can be enabled on an image layer and costs one credit per layer that uses it.

provenance.quote: Yes, enable background removal on the image layer and the subject is cut out at render time. It costs one credit per layer.

facts.statement: Rendering video at 60fps doubles the credit cost compared to 24 or 30fps, which are charged the same as each other.

provenance.quote: Yes. Rendering at 60fps doubles the cost. 24 and 30fps are charged the same as each other.

facts.statement: Bannerbear targets teams that need to generate many on-brand visual assets (social videos, ecommerce banners) programmatically at volume rather than designing each one by hand.
Bannerbear positions itself as usable directly from AI agents (Claude, Cursor or any MCP-enabled agent) to generate images, animations and workflows without manual design steps.

segment_objections.objection: We would be paying for a rendering tool before knowing it produces acceptable, on-brand output from our own catalog data.
segment_objections.answer: The trial starts with 30 API credits and no credit card, and gives one workspace with three image templates, three workflows and three instant URLs enforced identically via dashboard and API, so a real template can be filled from real data before any payment.

segment_objections.objection: Credit-based pricing makes our ongoing cost unpredictable at the volumes we would actually publish.
segment_objections.answer: The published tiers are fixed — $49/mo Automate with 1,000 credits and $149/mo Scale with 10,000 — and the documented multipliers are stated: credits count per requested format and are multiplied by the scale parameter, with higher Scale tiers shown but not separately priced.
